summary: Fix race condition in concurrent writes by implementing file locking using fcntl (Unix) with context manager pattern

root_cause.pattern: check-then-act race condition between load() and save()

test_first.description: Add failing regression test that uses multiprocessing to concurrently add todos and verifies no data loss

implementation_sequence.details: Implement file locking using fcntl.flock on Unix with timeout support
Create atomic_modify method that acquires lock, loads, applies mutation, and saves within single lock scope
Update add(), mark_done(), mark_undone(), remove() to use atomic_modify pattern

acceptance_criteria: Two processes calling add() concurrently do not lose data
Lock timeout provides clear error message

risks: NFS filesystems may have unreliable file locking
Orphan lock files if process crashes before cleanup

verification_targets.description: Two processes adding simultaneously must preserve both todos

verify_commands.ruff_lint: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/cli.py src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_storage_atomicity.py
verify_commands.ruff_format: uv run ruff format --check src/flywheel/cli.py src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_storage_atomicity.py

fixes_applied_during_verify.issue: F841: Local variable `lock_errors` is assigned to but never used
fixes_applied_during_verify.fix: Renamed to `_lock_errors` to indicate intentionally unused
